Marissa's internal notes:
- Acceptance matrix: add discrete examples for "functional correctness" (3 anonymized example queries and expected outputs) so clinical can run quick checks.
- Data access: clarify that only de-identified test set is necessary initially; include steps for on-prem proxy if needed.
- Risk: call out rate-limit behavior and mitigation steps if token-amp increases.

Week-by-week checklist (proposed):
Week0 (Tech validation, 3 days): env & credential exchange, prefix caching test, baseline latency measurement (p50/p95).
Week1 (Integration, 7 days): 1:1 integration with sample payloads, iterate prompt templates, track cost per token.
Week2 (Quality review, 7 days): run curated eval set, compare against acceptance thresholds, tune quantization/batching profile.
Week3 (Stability & scale, 7 days): stress test, throughput check against target QPS, fallback/variant routing validation.
Week4 (Sign-off & handoff, 6 days): final acceptance, runbook delivery, optional post-mortem and next-step proposal.

Tessa — can you pull the procurement checklist & standard SOW options we usually send for a 30d pilot? I'll mark owners and get the GDoc comments in by EOD.

Thanks,
Marissa
